d.title: Princess Connect! Re:Dive Season 2
d.jp: プリンセスコネクト! Re:Dive Season 2
d.synopsis: The members of the Gourmet Guild—Yuuki, Kokkoro, Pecorine, and Karyl—continue to scour the world in pursuit of their goal to seek out all delicious food in existence. However, as their adventures progress, the mysteries behind Yuuki's memories, Karyl's allegiance, and Pecorine's heritage begin to come together—seemingly forming the truth that makes up the world's very foundation.

rel.name: Princess Connect! Michibiki no Hatsuhana: Fiore Storia
